## Triage: first touch → `domain:server` · p3 (kept) · `pm:queue` · 2026-11-16T13:53Z

⛔ Not a claim.

The managed seal judges sealed package-scoped types (flow, page, app, agent, …) by name alone. A package's save of its own item is therefore refused when another package ships the same name. That contradicts ADR-0150 D1/D2, where identity is (package, type, name). The effect is real but narrow (same-name items across packages), so **p3** as filed, kept under the p3 standard. Suggested parent #31527.
